scope: DXF embedded MTEXT legacy API orientation; standalone MTEXT and DWG encoding are unchanged.

reference.rule: When both rotation and direction are supplied, the last supplied representation wins.

regression.previous_change: b526b240 omitted redundant group 50 when direction was available for independent parser compatibility.
regression.legacy_difference: Before that change a fresh embedded MTEXT with a nonzero angle and conflicting 2D direction emitted group 11 then group 50; the angle was authoritative. The later writer emitted only group 11 and produced the vector angle instead.
regression.reproduction: The upstream mtext-column-object-scope selector had ten fresh embedded cases expecting 30 degrees and reading 90 degrees. Instrumentation confirmed that the export and import succeeded with eight embedded records in each case; the six bad-read diagnostics belong to separate intentionally malformed negative controls.

fix: For fresh embedded LegacyApi objects, preserve nonzero angle precedence for conflicting 2D values while emitting only one orientation representation. Keep a matching direction vector and preserve any vector with a nonzero Z component. Source-parsed orientation modes and standalone MTEXT follow their existing paths. Relative direction comparison uses eight double-precision epsilons and scaled components.

validation.generated_cases: ASCII/Binary AC1032 embedded ATTDEF readback covers conflicting 2D, matching direction, retained 3D direction and a small real angle difference; input objects remain unchanged.
validation.ezdxf: ezdxf 1.4.5 independently read all eight generated embedded ATTRIB-definition profiles and recovered rotation or the expected complete direction vector.
validation.librecad: Disposable upstream-linked [mtext]~[dwg] selector passed 4 cases / 215 assertions with the documented consumer test patches applied.

limits: No broad native 3D application or whole-document interoperability claim.
No external DWG/DXF sample was committed.
